title: GTA6 Players in Germany May Legally Take Time Off Work
description: Discover how a unique legal loophole in Germany could allow a limited number of employees to take time off work for GTA6, with a catch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Unique Legal Loophole for GTA6 Players in Germany?

As the hype surrounding the release of *GTA6* continues to build globally, players are coming up with all sorts of plans to secure uninterrupted gaming time. Interestingly, a unique legal loophole in Germany has recently grabbed headlines, potentially allowing 60 employees to take time off work to play *GTA6* without putting their jobs in jeopardy.

## The Catch Behind the Loophole

While the prospect of leveraging local regulations to secure game time sounds like a dream come true for avid fans, there is a significant catch involved. The provision only applies to a very limited number of individuals, meaning the vast majority of players will still need to rely on standard vacation days or personal leave if they want to dive into the game on day one.

## Editor's Take

Finding a loophole to play a video game is a fun headline, but relying on standard PTO is probably safer for most. It certainly highlights the massive cultural impact of the game.
